result.topic_en: Gauss works with Gauss-type sums with powers of i (quartic periods T, T_1, U, U_1) modulo X and q to derive quadratic/biquadratic reciprocity relations between symbols (q/m), (m/q), (-q/m), treating the case q ≡ 3 mod 4 and splitting into q ≡ 3 and 7 mod 8.
result.transcription:
Diese beiden Congruenzen aequivaliren den Gleichungen
$\left(\frac{q}{m}\right)\left(\frac{m}{n}\right)^3\left(\frac{m'}{n}\right) = 1$ \quad oder was dasselbe ist \quad $\left(\frac{q}{m}\right)\left(\frac{m'}{n}\right) = \left(\frac{m}{n}\right)$
$\left(\frac{q}{m}\right)\left(\frac{m}{n'}\right)^3\left(\frac{m'}{n'}\right) = 1$ \quad\quad $\left(\frac{q}{m}\right)\left(\frac{m'}{n'}\right) = \left(\frac{m}{n'}\right)$
Da nun allgemein $\left(\frac{m'}{n}\right)\left(\frac{m}{n'}\right) = 1$, $\left(\frac{m'}{n'}\right)\left(\frac{m}{n}\right) = 1$
so wird wenn man obige Gleichungen resp. mit $\left(\frac{m}{n'}\right)$ [-multiplic-] $\left(\frac{m}{n}\right)$ multiplicirt
$\left(\frac{q}{m}\right) = \left(\frac{m}{n}\right)\left(\frac{m}{n'}\right) = \left(\frac{m}{q}\right)$

Der zweite Fall ist wo $q \equiv 3$ mod. 4
$T = x + ix^e - x^{ee} - ix^{e^3} +$
$T_1 = x - ix^e - x^{ee} + ix^{e^3} +$
$U = x^q + ix^{qe} - x^{qee} - ix^{qe^3} +$
$U_1 = x^q - ix^{qe} - x^{qee} + ix^{qe^3} + \ldots$

$\left(\frac{q}{m}\right) U \equiv T$ \quad (mod $X$)
$U_1 \equiv T_1 \left(\frac{q}{m}\right)$ \quad (mod $X$)
$T^q \equiv U_1$ mod $q$
$TT_1 \equiv (-1)^{\frac{1}{4}(p-1)} p$ (mod $X$)

$T^{q+1} \equiv \left(\frac{q}{m}\right) \cdot (-1)^{\frac{1}{4}(p-1)} \cdot p$ (mod $X$; $q$)
$T^{q+1} \equiv \left(\frac{-q}{m}\right) \cdot p$
$T^4 \equiv mmp$
$T^{q+1} \equiv m^{\frac{1}{2}(q+1)} p^{\frac{1}{4}(q+1)} \equiv \left(\frac{-q}{m}\right) p$
also
$m^{\frac{1}{2}(q+1)} p^{\frac{1}{4}(q-3)} \equiv \left(\frac{-q}{m}\right)$
Erheben zur Potenz $\frac{1}{2}(q-1)$
$m^{\frac{1}{4}(qq-1)} p^{\frac{1}{8}(q-3)(q-1)} \equiv \left(\frac{-q}{m}\right)^{\frac{1}{2}(q-1)}$

Also
$q \equiv 3$ mod 8 \quad $\left(\frac{m}{q}\right) \equiv \left(\frac{-q}{m}\right)$
$q \equiv 7$ mod 8 \quad * unten [?]
[-$\left(\frac{m}{q}\right) \equiv \left(\frac{-q}{m}\right)^3$-] ?

methods.what: Combining the two congruences with the general relations between symbols to derive the reciprocity (q/m) = (m/q)
Definition of quartic Gauss-type sums with coefficients powers of i
Frobenius-type congruence: q-th power of sum modulo q
Combining to get a congruence relating powers of m, p and the symbol (-q/m)
Raising to power (q-1)/2 (Euler criterion) to obtain the symbol (m/q)
Resulting reciprocity law for q ≡ 3 mod 8
